title: chromobench data pack manifest (schemaVersion 1)
description: manifest.json at the root of every pack in packages/data/packs/<packId>/. Written by tools/spektrafilm-export (canonical JSON: sorted keys, one-space indent); enforced by validateManifest in src/manifest.ts. The pack hash is sha256 of these bytes.

schemaVersion.description: Pack format version; the loader refuses a newer one (E_DATA_SCHEMA).

packId.description: <source>@<source version>[+<commit7>], e.g. spektrafilm@0.3.2+3bb2c2d; also the directory name.

sha256.description: Interim packs: hash of the CHB-001 file(s) they were converted from.

grid.description: Any other grid is refused with E_DATA_GRID.

missing.description: Missing-data policies the pack's source can honour (guide §6.4); others are refused with E_DATA_POLICY.

file.description: Licence text shipped unchanged in the pack; must be listed in files.

changelog.description: CHANGELOG.txt listing chromobench's modifications (required by the spektrafilm licence preamble).

contentHash.description: sha256 over the item's canonical JSON meaning (licence keys excluded) followed by its tensor bytes in name order; what TableKeys carry.

role.description: Stocks: 'print' when upstream info.stage == 'printing' (2383/2393 are print films).

illustrative.description: Not measured; the loader warns W_DATA_ILLUSTRATIVE.

missingRows_nm.description: Run-length summary [first, last, ...] of NaN rows per array.

onDemand.description: The file is not committed; this says how to generate it.

scanners.description: Camera/light packs: scanner setups built from their items.
